title: Yellowed Juicy Turkish Lamb Doner Kebab
description: A classic Turkish dish featuring juicy lamb stacked on a vertical spit and served in a crispy bun, perfect for midnight cravings. The lamb is cooked to perfection and served with fresh vegetables and tangy sauce.
instructions: Preheat a vertical spit or a large skillet over medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced lamb, onion, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Thread the lamb mixture onto the spit or cook in the skillet for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the doner kebab by slicing the cooked lamb into thin strips and serving it in the pita bread with tomato, cucumber, and yogurt sauce.
Cook the lamb to an internal temperature of 160 degrees for food safety.
Let the lamb rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the doner kebab immediately and enjoy.
Garnish with additional tomato, cucumber, and yogurt sauce if desired.
